gloss: head of a local government; chief

definitions.gloss: head of a local government (governor, mayor); chief; leader
definitions.explanation: The elected head of a prefecture, city, town, or village, covering governors and mayors alike. More generally, the head of a group or state, as in {首長国|しゅちょうこく} (emirate).

examples.japanese: {首長|しゅちょう}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Elections for local government heads were held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首長|しゅちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The mayors from across the prefecture met for a conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首長|しゅちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難指示|ひなんしじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: In a disaster, the head of the local government is responsible for issuing evacuation orders.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首長|しゅちょう}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: election of a governor or mayor
- ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首長|しゅちょう}: head of a local government
- アラブ{首長国連邦|しゅちょうこくれんぽう}: the United Arab Emirates

PRONUNCIATION:
In news broadcasts and meetings it is often said くびちょう, to keep it apart from the homophone ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧ (claim, assertion). The dictionary reading is しゅちょう.
